calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, remove the estimated 60-session beta exposure to the cross-asset median return from its five-session return, then negate and scale by its 20-session daily volatility. Higher values indicate unusually weak residual performance expected to mean-revert. Signals are computed only from completed historical sessions.

parameters.cross_asset_benchmark: median daily return across the 15 tradable watchlist instruments

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR passed the benchmark-wide absolute gates of 0.0070 and 0.0840. Subperiod daily IC/ICIR were 0.040843/0.118704 for 2020-2022, 0.038152/0.102772 for 2023-2024, and 0.028965/0.087059 for 2025-2026. Coverage is reduced by the 60-session beta warmup and minimum-data requirements; valid dates still average 12.18 instruments and meet the 8-name cross-sectional rule.
